Container.Name: fireside
Container.Overview:
Drop in an EPUB or paste a public story link and fireside narrates it, chapter by chapter.
Built for long serialized fiction: no subscription wall, no account required, runs on your own machine. Bring your own TTS key (Azure, OpenAI-compatible, MiniMax) or point it at a local engine such as Kokoro and it costs nothing per word. Open source (MIT).
• EPUB, pasted story links, and Archive of Our Own (with optional login cookie) • Per-chapter audio you can replay, plus continuous "whole book" mode • Local filesystem storage by default; SQLite metadata by default, MySQL/MariaDB optional • Character-capacity accounting hooks for hosted use; self-host is free
First run: open the WebUI, add a speech engine on the Settings page, drop in a book, and press play.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the fireside WebUI and API.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Library metadata and content-addressed audio blobs. Point this at appdata so your library survives container updates.

Config.Name: Data Dir
Config.Description: Where the host keeps its state inside the container. Leave as /data unless you changed the path above.

Config.Name: Database Engine
Config.Description: sqlite (default, zero setup) or mysql. Set to mysql to use an external MySQL/MariaDB server; metadata moves to that server, audio blobs stay under the Data path.

Config.Name: Database Connection
Config.Description: Only used when Database Engine is mysql. Form: user:password@host:3306/dbname (or a full mysql:// DSN). Matches the FIRESIDE_DB_CONN env var in the README.

Config.Name: Plugins Root
Config.Description: Directory the host scans for reader/speech/storage plugins. Leave default unless you mount a custom plugin set.
